name: Dirk van der Meer
bio:
Dirk's path to motorsport PR wasn't a straight line. He started in journalism, covering local racing events for a small newspaper in the Netherlands. This ignited a passion for the sport, but Dirk realized his talents lay more in shaping the narrative than simply reporting it. He transitioned to a communications role within a smaller racing team, honing his skills in media relations and crisis management.

At Walkenhorst Motorsport, Dirk thrives on the fast-paced environment and the challenge of promoting the team's achievements. He's known for his ability to build strong relationships with journalists and influencers, ensuring the team gets the coverage it deserves. Dirk's meticulous approach and understanding of the Dutch media landscape make him a valuable asset, especially when the team races in Europe. He believes in transparency and honesty, even when delivering challenging news, earning him respect throughout the paddock.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Dirk is of average height with a slightly athletic build, often seen wearing team apparel.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with media contacts and potential story ideas.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when he's feeling stressed or under pressure.
Insists on having a specific type of Dutch licorice in his office at all times.
